subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — UI dashboard and CLI command

question: Should OpenClaw own this AI-safety taxonomy as a core diagnostics contract with persistent operator UI/CLI surfaces and a plugin emission API?
rationale: This series creates permanent contracts across core diagnostics, plugin authorization, persisted operator state, gateway protocol, telemetry, CLI, and Control UI; automation cannot safely select those ownership and privacy boundaries.

options.title: Approve a core design
options.body: Specify the canonical schema, SQLite retention model, bounded privacy contract, gateway protocol, and plugin authorization boundary before continuing implementation.

options.title: Narrow to diagnostics
options.body: Expose selected safety signals through existing diagnostic and exporter surfaces without adding a parallel store, dashboard, or plugin API.

options.title: Pause the series
options.body: Defer or close the stacked work until a maintainer sponsors the broader safety-observability roadmap.

recommendation.title: Approve a core design
recommendation.body: Specify the canonical schema, SQLite retention model, bounded privacy contract, gateway protocol, and plugin authorization boundary before continuing implementation.

likelyOwner.reason: This is a cross-cutting product and architecture decision spanning core, plugin, security, storage, gateway, CLI, telemetry, and UI ownership.
